'''2010 Yavin 4 Regionals Steve Yaeger LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Yaeger]] at [[2010 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
